visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with reddish-brown hair, wearing a navy blue 'USA 4' Nike jersey, stands in a brightly lit indoor living space. She has an annoyed facial expression with furrowed brows and hands on her hips. (2) She begins gesturing with both hands while speaking to the camera; cartoonish question marks and a thinking face emoji appear above her head as she expresses frustration. (3) She holds up a yellow spray can with a red and black label featuring a crocodile logo and Chinese text; she points to the product and shakes it slightly to demonstrate its use. (4) The scene transitions to a close-up of a semi-transparent yellow trash bag covered in dozens of small, dark fruit flies stuck to its surface; a small inset circle at the bottom corner shows the woman cheering and smiling. (5) She returns to the main frame holding the spray can with a bright smile, giving a thumbs-up to the camera while pointing enthusiastically at the product's label.
